column4: A cancelled statistics tour can no longer replace your own statistics after its background loading finishes.
Sample preparation and cleanup now run in sequence, retaining the safeguards that protect genuine run history.
Added controlled background-worker tests proving cancelled tours stay cancelled and current tours still open.
Recorded the preceding build's successful checks and Android screenshots, alongside remaining testing and execution limitations.
I fixed a race that could reopen sample statistics after a tour was cancelled. Genuine history, statistics calculations and the current tour's normal behavior remain unchanged.
